_anchor_doc: Flags-off lever anchors, IMAGE512 arm (256tok eri2 cache, seed 42, rank32/alpha32, lr 1e-4). DEFAULT (bf16+device, LTX2_FAST semantics — band-gated vs the musubi oracle 07-17, inside 1 SEM, grad-dist clean): steps 1-4 loss = 0.6094/0.6905/0.4911/1.0097, grad_norm 0.0354/0.0130/0.0204/0.0129 — deterministic across 3 lead runs on the FINAL consolidated binary (a pre-consolidation build printed 0.6902/0.4912/1.0096 — binary-iteration class, not run wobble). ESCAPE (LTX2_F32_STACK=1): 0.6093/0.6901/0.4911/1.0092, grad 0.0317/0.0130/0.0292/0.0123 — the F32-era exact anchors, byte-stable. Speed: default ~6.7-7.3 s/step vs escape ~8.2-9.2.
